name: Phase gadget fusion
summary: Two phase gadgets on the same set of spiders fuse together, and their phases add.
description:
A *phase gadget* is a phase-free X-spider connected to a number of Z-spiders, with one extra leg ending in a Z-spider carrying a phase. Phase gadgets represent diagonal unitaries: a gadget connected to qubits $q_1,\ldots,q_n$ with phase α implements $e^{-i\frac{\alpha}{2} Z\otimes\cdots\otimes Z}$ (up to a global phase). Two phase gadgets connected to exactly the same set of spiders fuse into a single gadget whose phase is the sum of the two.

This is the basis of the phase-teleportation T-count optimisation of PyZX.
parameter_notes: n is the number of spiders the gadgets are connected to (shown for n = 2).
